generator: render.mjs deterministic SVG geometry; Chromium Canvas 2D PNG rasterization
description: Sparse soft round pale flakes, varied radius and opacity.
boundaryWrapping: Each particle has all nine toroidal neighbor copies, clipped inside a repeating 256px SVG pattern. Snow blur is applied before tile clipping.

recommendedMotion.coordinateSystem: screen x-right, y-down; source pixels at 1:1 display scale
recommendedMotion.note: Move texture in this direction; reduce speed proportionally when scaling the texture. One loop translates by integer multiples of both repeat periods.

provenance.process: Simple original seeded strokes, circles and polygon flecks; no terrain or background pixels are painted.

limitations: Draft particle density, opacity and speeds need motion review in the actual scene.
Pattern repeats every 256 pixels; the small repeat unit can become visible at high opacity.
These files contain particle art only. No runtime animation, weather logic, terrain, fog or gameplay changes are included.
